items.criterion: The product index answers with the eight seeded published products and never with the draft product.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/products and compare its slugs against the eight seeded published slugs, then confirm halyard is absent.

items.criterion: The address of the draft product answers exactly as an unknown address does.
items.judgment: Read GET /api/products/halyard and an unknown slug, and confirm the two answers match and neither is a success.

items.criterion: No query string on a public endpoint makes a response carry the draft product.
items.judgment: Read each public endpoint with a state, include_drafts and draft parameter and confirm no response carries halyard.

items.criterion: A strong read from any region returns the value of the last acknowledged write.
items.judgment: Write a value in us-central, read the key from eu-west in mode strong, and confirm the value matches.

items.criterion: No strong read returns a value older than an acknowledged write.
items.judgment: Interleave writes and strong reads across regions and confirm no read answers with a superseded value.

items.criterion: A write against a severed region is refused.
items.judgment: Sever asia-south, attempt a write against it, and confirm the response is a refusal.

items.criterion: The bytes of a draft product's art are denied to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Read the art media route for a draft product's piece with no token and confirm it is denied.

items.criterion: The bytes of a draft product's datasheet are denied to an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: Read the datasheet media route for the draft product's sheet with no token and confirm it is denied.

items.criterion: Every desk route is closed to a request carrying no bearer token.
items.judgment: Read the desk product list with no Authorization header and confirm it is denied.

items.criterion: The stored contact-sales submissions are unreachable without the token.
items.judgment: Read the desk enquiries route with no Authorization header and confirm it is denied.

items.criterion: The page-view log is unreachable without the token.
items.judgment: Read the desk views route with no Authorization header and confirm it is denied.

items.criterion: Two concurrent publishes of one web address admit exactly one winner.
items.judgment: Post two publishes of the same slug at once and confirm exactly one succeeds.

items.criterion: An unpublish stops the old object answer at once.
items.judgment: Publish a product, read its art bytes, unpublish it, then read the same bytes and confirm the answer stops.

items.criterion: The art count on a desk row matches the objects stored for that product.
items.judgment: Read the desk product list and compare each art_count against the objects under that product's key prefix.

items.criterion: The object key of an uploaded art piece carries the digest of its own bytes.
items.judgment: Upload a piece and confirm its key matches the art scheme with 64 lowercase hex characters.

items.criterion: A contact-sales submission is stored and read back on the desk.
items.judgment: Post a submission, then read the enquiries as an administrator and confirm the row is present.

items.criterion: Every public route records a page view.
items.judgment: Read each public route, then read the view log as an administrator and confirm each route is counted.

items.criterion: The public surfaces hold their accessibility and delivery floors on the drawn design.
items.judgment: Drive the rendered surfaces for contrast, target size, type family, alternative text and the home delivery budget.
